Body.Content:
Update Rollup 34 for Azure Site Recovery is now available. It provides new versions of these components:

  • Microsoft Azure Site Recovery Unified Setup/Mobility agent for Windows, CentOS, Ubuntu (9.22.5142)—used for replication from VMware and physical servers to Azure.
  • Microsoft Azure Site Recovery Configuration Server (version 5.1.3950.0)—used for replication from VMware and physical servers to Azure.
  • Microsoft Azure Site Recovery Provider (5.1.3950.0)—used for Hyper-V replication to Azure or a secondary site.
  • Microsoft Azure Recovery Services Agent (2.0.9155.0)—used for replication of Hyper-V to Azure.

You can apply the rollup on deployments running:

  • Unified Setup version 9.18.xxxx.x or later.
  • Microsoft Azure Site Recovery Provider for System Center VMM version 3.4.486 or later.
  • Microsoft Azure Site Recovery Provider 5.1.3500.0 or later.
  • Microsoft Azure Site Recovery Provider for Hyper-V 4.6.660 or later.

For more information about the rollup fixes, and for installation instructions, read KB 4490016.
